name: Oribe Kokoro
source:
"Nii-san, I'm your place to come home to! ♪" 

A pretty girl who draws in the customers at her [url=/c49964]mother's[/url] cafe, Origami. She takes good care of her friends and has a cheerful and straightforward personality, but her cooking is truly catastrophic. She might have inherited some of her [url=/c49964]mother's[/url] airheadness. Few know that she has a more adventurous side -- she's even finding herself attracted to her new [url=/c45359]"brother"[/url].


Special skills: Being considerate
Hobbies: Reading books (often borrows them from the library)
Likes: Relaxing, texting, her "[url=/c45359]brother[/url]"(it's a secret)
Dislikes: C*ckr**ches, high places, silence

[Based on translation from the [url=http://www.purplesoftware.jp/products/amatsutsumi/#prettyPhoto]Developer's Site[/url]]
